description.html: This glass terrarium (45x35x35 cm, 55.1 L) comes with exterior decorative film in a pattern of your choice. The glass gives a clear view of the inside, while film on three sides gives the animals a sense of security.

A length of 45 cm and a width of 35 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. The ample length allows a temperature gradient from a warm to a cool zone, which every reptile needs to stay healthy. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.

We offer full customization: you choose the film, background and ventilation, plus optional LED lighting or a thermostat. If this model doesn't fit your space, we build terrariums in any dimensions. Call for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
